0.content: Sandrone, the Seventh Harbinger and Alain Guillotin's automaton, is Columbina's best friend, though Sandrone would never say so. Columbina first followed her around trying to work out how the wind-up key on her back moved, until Sandrone whirled round and offered to put a key on her too; Columbina wore one for a few days and has "looked out for her even more since then". At a restaurant, when Columbina froze before a frightened clerk holding the bill, Sandrone filled in the reimbursement slip, put her on Sandrone's tab and asked, "Isn't this just who you are?" No "you should be", no "you could do better": that acceptance made her happy. Sandrone publicly calls her a nuisance with "zero social graces".

1.comment: Columbina: Silvermoon Hall and the kuuhenki
1.content: Silvermoon Hall is a cavern on Hiisi Island where Columbina hid after leaving the Fatui: a field of blue flowers, pools of water, and a rocking chair for moongazing. A great boulder once sealed it from the Scions and the Fatui; after 6.3 she rolled it aside, because hiding no longer seemed necessary and her friends had invited her into their homes. Kuuhenki, the small moon spirits of Nod-Krai, live with her. She tells them stories, sings them to sleep, has snowball fights with them and prefers their company because they never hide their thoughts.

2.comment: Columbina: Lauma and the Frostmoon Scions
2.content: The Frostmoon Scions of Hiisi Island, descendants of Hyperborea, awaited a prophesied new Moon Goddess. When Kuutar was born they worshipped her, carved Statues of the New Moon in her image and asked for more than she could give, until she left. Generations later Lauma, the current Moonchanter, met her, apologised for her ancestors' greed, and asked her to stay hidden for both their sakes, a request Lauma herself calls a little rude. Lauma dreams that the moon and her believers can one day share a toast. After 6.3 Columbina took her advice and came to live among the Scions.

3.content: Roughly a century after her birth, Kuutar left the Scions and accepted the Tsaritsa's offer of a "second home". She was made the Third of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers under the names Columbina and The Damselette. She was never sent to seize a Gnosis or anything else; the Tsaritsa sought only a Moon Goddess's power. She asked repeatedly when her task would begin and was told "the time has not yet come", so she walked, watched the moon and sang. Tartaglia never understood why "that girl" ranked third and felt something was off about her. The Wanderer called her oblivious and unfeeling. Arlecchino called her a very special Harbinger whose answers are always interesting.

4.content: Dottore was the first Harbinger to approach her, politely asking for help with kuuvahki and Light Realm research. She liked being offered a choice and enjoyed his early praise. Then the praise became "Not quite enough" and "You're capable of more", and she realised he saw only the power she ought to reach. He called her a sister and meant it: "What's a little discomfort among family? We endure for each other, surely." It reminded her of the Scions' eyes beneath the altar, so she stopped helping him. At Signora's funeral she innocently asked after "the Segment in the prime of his life".

5.content: For centuries Columbina did not recognise herself in any of her names (Kuutar, The Damselette, Goddess) and told the Traveler to pick "whichever takes your fancy". After Rerir's expulsion her strength failed and Teyvat's rejection began to erase her. Alice and Nicole explained that she had no anchor in the world, no name she had chosen. She drifted unseen through Nasha Town and the Frostmoon Enclave and could not follow her friends into the Hyperborean ruins. Nicole realised a name need not come from the past; the Traveler went to Silvermoon Hall and called "Columbina", and she returned whole. She named herself Columbina Hyposelenia, "born beneath the moon", and by extension "born beneath this world".
